# Objective

One coherent objective, per `docs/WORKFLOW.md`.

## Package frame

Class (S / M / L / XL) with the change surfaces included, explicit exclusions where they prevent
scope drift, and the checkpoint plan for L/XL.

## Evidence

Every material claim names the exact public SHA it proves. Required gates as
**PASS / FAIL / UNKNOWN** with run IDs or evidence paths; a missing artifact is UNKNOWN, not
inferred PASS.
